t: You are at the corner of Coleman Street and Gresham Street, where St Stephen's Church once stood. It was also called St Stephen's in the Jewry, and it is first mentioned in the twelfth century. In the middle ages it is described variously as a parish church and as a chapel of ease to St Olave Old Jewry. Its parish status was settled permanently in 1456. Sir Christopher Wren is named as its designer. He is the architect of St Paul's Cathedral.
